items.headline: Wind Advisory issued August 16 at 1:56PM AKDT until August 17 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 40 mph expected.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...From 7 AM to 10 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult by air, land, and sea.
Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued August 16 at 12:33PM AKDT until August 19 at 6:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Including the following areas, Central Susitna Valley,
Southern Susitna Valley and Western Susitna Valley. This includes
the cities of Skwentna, Willow, Talkeetna, Trapper Creek, And
Petersville.

* WHEN...From 7 PM AKDT this evening through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Significant
items.areas: Western Susitna Valley; Southern Susitna Valley; Central Susitna Valley
items.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further informat

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued August 16 at 5:40AM AKDT until August 17 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts 55 to 65 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Anchorage Hillside / Eagle River.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 1 AM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Southeasterly winds are expected to quickly
increase this morning. The peak of the winds is expected during the
evening hours before winds rapidly decrease in strength around
midnight.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 16 at 3:17AM AKDT until August 16 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 80 expected.

* WHERE...Arctic Plains, especially near Umiat.

* WHEN...From 1 PM this afternoon to 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Temperatures cool Monday and are not expected
to warm to these levels again for the rest of the week.
items.areas: Western Arctic Plains; Central Arctic Plains
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.
